records.title: Post-Training Probability Manifold Correction via Structured SVD Pruning and Self-Referential Distillation
records.reason: SparseKD uses structured SVD pruning with self-distillation; the abstract reports 15-65% parameter reduction and identifies reduced dense inference computation.

records.title: RoMeo: Mitigating Dual-dimensional Outliers with Rotated Mixed Precision Quantization
records.reason: The official PPoPP abstract connects dual-dimensional mixed-precision quantization with LLM serving and reports up to 2.10x end-to-end speedup.

records.title: Superlinear Multi-Step Attention
records.reason: The paper proposes subquadratic attention for long-context language models and reports decoding throughput at million-token contexts.

records.title: Power-based Partial Attention: Bridging Linear-Complexity and Full Attention
records.reason: PPA interpolates between linear-window and full attention and reports comparable results at subquadratic complexity, a direct attention-efficiency contribution.

records.title: On the Limits of Learned Importance Scoring for KV Cache Compression
records.reason: SIP evaluates an LLM KV-cache compression scorer and documents its limitations against simple baselines; negative results directly inform inference cache design.

records.title: Gecko: An Efficient Neural Architecture Inherently Processing Sequences with Arbitrary Lengths
records.reason: Gecko proposes a sequence architecture with sliding-chunk attention and adaptive working memory, reporting long-context scalability; this is a directly relevant transformer alternative.

records.title: Toward Cost-Efficient LLM Serving: A System-Level Memory Optimization Approach
records.reason: The IEEE abstract describes LLM-serving memory management and scheduling across VRAM/DRAM/NVMe, reporting throughput, latency, and VRAM improvements.

records.title: Dynamic Quantization Error Propagation in Encoder-Decoder ASR Quantization
records.reason: The primary abstract targets encoder-decoder speech-recognition models and word-error rate; it does not establish LLM inference efficiency.

records.title: Mico: efficient query scheduling for multi-cloud deployed LLM inference service
records.reason: The Springer abstract studies multi-cloud LLM inference scheduling and flexible batching, reporting reduced KV-cache use and higher service throughput.

records.title: FRM-PTQ: Feature relationship matching enhanced low-bit post-training quantization for large language models
records.reason: The Elsevier abstract describes low-bit LLM PTQ with customized quantization kernels and reports 2x throughput with reduced memory use.

records.title: EDSD: Entropy-Driven Design for Faster Speculative Decoding
records.reason: The ACL abstract ties entropy-guided draft training and design to speculative decoding and reports a 4.1% speedup against prior methods.

records.title: RoBSA: RoPE-based Blockwise Sparse Multi-head Latent Attention
records.reason: The ACL abstract targets sparse MLA attention during LLM decoding and reports up to 2.55x lower end-to-end inference latency.

records.title: Rethinking Output Alignment For 1-bit Post-Training Quantization of Large Language Models
records.reason: This paper develops output-aligned 1-bit PTQ for LLM deployment, directly targeting low-memory, low-compute quantized inference.

records.title: RAPID-LLM: Resilience-Aware Performance analysis of Infrastructure for Distributed LLM Training and Inference
records.reason: The framework models inference operators, memory, interconnect congestion, and feasibility to compare deployment choices; this is a direct systems-performance evaluation contribution.

records.title: CTkvr: KV Cache Retrieval for Long-Context LLMs via Centroid then Token Indexing
records.reason: CTkvr targets KV-cache memory access and long-context decoding latency through two-stage retrieval.

records.title: SASQ: Static Activation Scaling for Quantization-Aware Training in Large Language Models
records.reason: SASQ targets static activation quantization for efficient LLM deployment, avoiding dynamic quantization overhead while retaining model accuracy.

records.title: MIDUS: Memory-Infused Depth Up-Scaling
records.reason: MIDUS provides retrieval-based residual capacity rather than duplicated dense FFN branches and reports performance and efficiency improvements.

records.title: Resting Neurons, Active Insights: Improving Input Sparsification for Large Language Models
records.reason: The official arXiv v4 record under the DOI-matched ID describes SPON for reliable activation-sparse LLM inference; its input title differs, so the stable arXiv ID resolves the same work.

records.title: Parallel Decoder Transformer: Model-Internal Parallel Decoding with Speculative Invariance via Note Conditioning
records.reason: The official arXiv v3 title differs from the selected input title under the same DOI-matched ID. It proposes model-intrinsic parallel generation, a directly relevant decoding architecture, but explicitly says training and held-out evaluation are in progress and reports no positive empirical result.

records.title: GatedFWA: Linear Flash Windowed Attention with Gated Associative Memory
records.reason: GatedFWA combines linear-time windowed attention with a fused kernel for autoregressive language models, targeting sequence-length compute and I/O efficiency.
